summary: Discussion-led pulse: vendor incident and security signals (OpenAI/Hugging Face, Copilot), policy changes, and many early-stage agent harness projects; several single-repo launches need corroboration. | Official-vendor product and infra updates: Anthropic Opus/Fable releases, Vercel AI Gateway model additions, Mistral product pages, AWS & JetBrains operator how-tos, plus MCP/sandbox infra notes. | GitHub snapshot: agent orchestration and infra tooling dominate. Notable platform releases (dify, mem0, OpenAI/Claude/Google releases) plus several infra primitives (deterministic orchestrator, zero-trust exec, Playwright test harness) and operator-facing runbooks/CLIs. | Package-registry signals: several mainstream vendor CLIs/extensions (OpenAI, GitHub, Amazon) plus infra primitives for MCP, security, and agent memory; mostly single-source package entries — social/user reports missing.
